cues.en: The way that we go about computing this correlation is through a procedure called the correlation coefficient.

cues.en: So we have X and Y.

cues.zh: 可以把x叫作上過Mike課程的數量，y叫人生快樂程度；x、y上方的橫線，

cues.en: on top of the X and Y refers to the mean or the average value.
cues.zh: 代表平均數，也就是平均值。

cues.en: So essentially this means you take each individual element in X and each individual element and Y subtract
cues.zh: 基本上，對x和y的每個元素，分別減去，

cues.en: the respective means from that variable and then element Y's multiply and then some ha.

cues.en: Doesn't that sound familiar element wise multiply and then sum up all of those multiplications.

cues.en: So that's the numerator of the Peerson correlation coefficient.

cues.en: The denominator has two terms and it initially looks a little confusing.

cues.en: So you take each individual element in X, subtract the mean and then square it.
cues.zh: 對x每個元素減平均，再平方。

cues.en: So when you're squaring it, you're actually just multiplying this term by itself.
cues.zh: 平方其實就是這一項乘自己。

cues.en: And now if you multiply this term by itself, that's really just like what you see in the numerator, except this is X and X instead of here, this is X and Y.
cues.zh: 這項乘自己，其實很像分子，只是這裡是x和x，那裡是x和y。

cues.en: So in fact, what you see in the denominator here is the dot product of X with itself.
cues.zh: 所以分母這裡，其實是x和自己的內積。

cues.en: And then you take the square root of that times the dot product of y with itself, and then you take the square root of that and there you go.
cues.zh: 再取平方根，乘上y和自己的內積的平方根，就好了。
